summary: Regression-tested live assessment APIs and frontend. Backend text flow, persistence, all three real non-uniform image formats, malformed base64 rejection, and uniform-image rejection passed. Frontend loaded and mobile navigation had no horizontal overflow, but browser submission encountered a Cloudflare origin invalid/incomplete response.

integration_issues.issue: Browser-facing POST did not reach results during this run; page displayed Cloudflare origin invalid/incomplete response.

action_items: Investigate intermittent Cloudflare/origin response affecting browser POST; rerun frontend flow after infrastructure stability is confirmed.
seed_data_creation: Created one text assessment and three image assessments (TEST_JPEG, TEST_PNG, TEST_WEBP) during live API testing; records remain in history.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Strict backend image validation is verified for JPEG/PNG/WEBP, malformed base64, and uniform PNG. Mobile form/history navigation passes. Browser result/history integration needs rerun because Cloudflare returned an origin invalid/incomplete response.
rca of the issue: The API regression suite independently completed all POST requests successfully, while the browser request displayed a Cloudflare-generated origin error. This indicates an intermittent preview ingress/origin availability issue rather than reproduced application validation failure; inspect ingress and frontend browser network/server logs on retest.
